# 1. Load and inspect headers
df = read_df("final_grades_math201_s03.csv")
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print("Rows:", len(df))

# 2. Detect the rubric-version column (case/format tolerant)
candidates = [c for c in df.columns if "rubric" in c.lower() or "version" in c.lower()]
print("Candidate rubric columns:", candidates)

if not candidates:
    print("No rubric-version column present in the file.")
else:
    col = candidates[0]
    # 3. Missing values
    missing = df[df[col].isna()]
    # 4. Present but not rubric_v4 (normalize whitespace/case for matching)
    norm = df[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    not_v4 = df[(~df[col].isna()) & (norm != "rubric_v4")]
    print(f"Missing rubric version: {len(missing)} rows")
    print(f"Not rubric_v4: {len(not_v4)} rows")
    print(df.loc[missing.index.union(not_v4.index), :])
